name: Physlib Formalisation Report: The reflectionless (Pöschl–Teller) potential and its ladder operators, with the analytic properties of tanh they need
description: Physlib Contribution Report on work by Afiq Hatta: “The reflectionless (Pöschl–Teller) potential and its ladder operators, with the analytic properties of tanh they need”.

issuer.name: Physlib Contributions
issuer.description: An open-source community project to digitalize results from physics into Lean 4. Physlib Contributions publishes signed reports on reviewing, maintenance, refactoring, foundations, formalisation and documentation of Physlib.

credentialSubject.narrative:
Formalised the reflectionless potential V(x) ∝ −sech²(κx) as a one-dimensional quantum system, together with its creation and annihilation operators, built from the momentum operator and tanh(κx).

To make these operators act on Schwartz functions, proved the facts about tanh they rely on: every derivative of tanh is a polynomial in tanh, so all derivatives are bounded; tanh is smooth; and tanh(κx) has temperate growth. With this, the ladder operators are defined as continuous linear maps on Schwartz space. The tanh results are in Mathematics/ForMathlib/Trigonometry/Tanh and are marked for upstreaming to Mathlib; the quantum-mechanics part has since been moved by others into QuantumMechanics/PoschlTeller, where it still builds on this work.

achievement.name: Physlib Formalisation Report
achievement.description: For adding to Physlib or PhyslibAlpha: new lemmas and definitions, and results from physics stated and proved on top of what is already there. This includes many small additions across different areas, as well as one larger result.

criteria.narrative:
- The work added new lemmas, definitions or results to Physlib or PhyslibAlpha, rather than restructuring existing code or setting up the basic definitions of an area.
- The work was merged and follows the library’s conventions.
- Links to the relevant pull requests are given as evidence.
